profile_text.body:
Celestica Inc. describes itself as a technology leader with expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and platform solutions. According to its website, the company engineers, designs and manufactures what it calls the backbone of AI and cloud technology, and it says it enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud. It also states that it advances technologies in high-growth markets and helps customers achieve a competitive advantage.

The company's website does not name specific AI products. Its positioning centers on design, engineering, and manufacturing for data center infrastructure, with a stated focus on AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud markets.

Celestica Inc. is a for-profit public company with ticker CLS and SEC CIK 0001030894. Its headquarters is listed as Toronto, A6. No litigation cases or MCP servers are recorded for the company.
